figurative_meaning_en: avoiding facing someone, often due to shame or guilt
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথা দিয়ে কথা না রাখতে পেরে সে এখন মুখ লুকোচ্ছে।
ভুল করে ফেলার পর ছেলেটি লজ্জায় মুখ লুকালো।
example_sentences_in_english: After failing to keep his promise, he is now hiding his face.
After making a mistake, the boy hid his face in shame.
note: This idiom reflects everyday Bengali expressions of embarrassment or evasion.
